    """Assert all structural invariants of an InquiryResult."""

    assert len(dm.matched_terms) == len(dm.scores), (

class TestMergeDimensionMatches:

    async def test_happy_path_merge_with_overlap(self):
        """Merges embedding and keyword matches, deduplicates, keeps highest score."""
        emb_match = make_dimension_match(
            matched_terms=("Alice", "Bob"),
            scores=(0.9, 0.7),
            method="embedding_similarity",
        )
        kw_match = make_dimension_match(
            matched_terms=("Bob", "Charlie"),
            scores=(0.8, 0.6),
            method="keyword_overlap",
        )
        result = merge_dimension_matches(
            embedding_match=emb_match,
            keyword_match=kw_match,
        )
        assert result.method == "combined"
        assert_valid_dimension_match(result, "merge")
        # Bob appears in both — should keep highest score (0.8 from keyword? or 0.7 from embedding? contract says higher)
        terms_list = list(result.matched_terms)
        scores_dict = dict(zip(result.matched_terms, result.scores))
        assert "Alice" in terms_list, "Alice should be in merged result"
        assert "Bob" in terms_list, "Bob should be in merged result"
        assert "Charlie" in terms_list, "Charlie should be in merged result"
        # Bob: max(0.7, 0.8) = 0.8
        assert scores_dict["Bob"] == max(0.7, 0.8), (
            f"Bob's score should be max of both: got {scores_dict['Bob']}"
        )
        assert_sorted_descending(result.scores, "merge")

class TestLargeInput:
